item.title: github: GitHub Enterprise adds credential inventory exports
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise now lets enterprise owners export a complete inventory of credentials that can access the enterprise. The export includes SSH keys, classic and fine-grained personal access tokens, OAuth App access tokens, and other credential types.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Workflow execution protections in GitHub Actions generally available
item.description:
Workflow execution protections in GitHub Actions are now generally available for GitHub Enterprise, organizations, and repositories. The feature lets you define an allowlist to control who can execute workflows.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot suggests custom properties definitions
item.description:
GitHub Copilot can now suggest allowed values when creating custom properties for repositories in an organization. The feature is in public preview for GitHub Copilot Business and Copilot users.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprise Live Migrations from GHES to ghe.com generally available
item.description:
Enterprise Live Migrations is now generally available for near-zero-downtime repository migrations from GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) to GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Data Residency (GHEC DR).

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprise team specialization for managed settings
item.description:
Enterprise administrators can now apply managed settings using itemized configuration files targeted at enterprise teams. This lets large organizations delegate more specific governance without routing every change through central admins or relying on a single global configuration.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprise teams model policy targeting in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has added user-based model policy targeting for enterprise teams in public preview. It is available to GitHub Enterprise customers with Copilot Business or Copilot Enterprise licenses and lets AI administrators set a baseline policy.

  • Source: GitHub
